name: Candelabrum cactus
desc: Candelabrum cactus (Cylindropuntia imbricata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Cylindropuntia imbricata, the cane cholla, is a cactus found in the Southwestern United States and northern Mexico, including some cooler regions in comparison to many other cacti.
